description: This file contains unit tests for trigger decoding, noise filtering, and RPM calculation in an engine control system. It simulates various noisy pulse signals and verifies the decoder's robustness against noise.

methods.name: void fireEvent(EngineTestHelper * eth,bool isRise)
methods.description: Fires a trigger event, either rise or fall, depending on the isRise flag, considering trigger noise filtering settings.

methods.name: void noisyPulse(EngineTestHelper * eth,int idx,int durationUs,bool isRise,int noiseIdx,int durationNoiseUs,int offsetNoiseUs,int numSpikes)
methods.description: Simulates a pulse with optional noise spikes within a given duration, triggering appropriate events on the EngineTestHelper.

methods.name: void fireNoisyCycle60_2(EngineTestHelper * eth,int numCycles,int durationUs,int noiseIdx,int durationNoiseUs,int offsetNoiseUs,int numSpikes)
methods.description: Simulates multiple cycles of a 60-2 tooth wheel signal, with added noise spikes at specified positions.

methods.name: void resetTrigger(EngineTestHelper & eth)
methods.description: Resets and applies trigger shape, and clears accumulated trigger data in the engine.

methods.name: void testNoiselessDecoderProcedure(EngineTestHelper & eth,int errorToleranceCnt DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SUFFIX)
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on the noiseless trigger decoder, adding noise spikes to confirm robustness and error counts against various noise conditions.
